title: Fit a Capture-Recapture Model — crc_fit
code: crc_fit(   data,   captures,   capture_formula,   outcome = NULL,   outcome_formula = NULL,   outcome_dist = c("ztnegbin", "ztpois"),   misclass = NULL,   latent_classes = 1L,   control = NULL )

title: Fit a Capture-Recapture Model — crc_fit
text: data data.frame data.table one row per observed unit. captures one-sided formula identifying binary capture indicators, e.g., ~ source_1 + source_2 + source_3. capture_formula one-sided formula specifying log-linear capture model. special term .latent denotes latent class. outcome Either NULL, single column name exactly observed outcome, named character vector c(lower = "lower_column", upper = "upper_column"). outcome_formula one-sided formula mean outcome distribution. Must NULL outcome = NULL. outcome_dist zero-truncated outcome distribution. Currently, "ztnegbin" "ztpois" supported. misclass specification misclassification mechanisms. latent_classes positive integer giving number latent classes. control optional control list; init_alpha currently supported.
